# Ample Removals

> Ample Removals is a removal and house clearance company based in Thatcham, Berkshire (41 Rosedale Garden, Thatcham, RG19 3LE), serving Newbury, Thatcham and the surrounding West Berkshire area for over 7 years. Services: house removals, man and van, house clearance, rubbish removal, and end-of-tenancy cleaning. Phone: 0333 577 2070. Email: hello@ampleremovals.com.

## Primary local pages

- [Removals in Newbury](https://www.ampleremovals.com/locations/newbury): Full house-removal service for Newbury, Berkshire, operated from a base a few miles away in Thatcham. Covers Wash Common, Speen, Donnington, Greenham, Cold Ash and the wider Newbury area. Includes local moving guides, FAQs and instant pricing.
- [Removals in Thatcham](https://www.ampleremovals.com/locations/thatcham): Ample Removals' home town and registered office (41 Rosedale Garden, Thatcham, RG19 3LE). Covers the Broadway, Crookham, Henwick, Colthrop and Dunston Park. Includes local moving guides, FAQs and instant pricing.

## Services

- [House Removals](https://www.ampleremovals.com/booking): Full-service domestic and commercial removals with an instant Standard/Premium price.
- [Man and Van](https://www.ampleremovals.com/booking/man-and-van): Hourly-priced man and van service, £45/hr for one man, £75/hr for two.
- [House Clearance](https://www.ampleremovals.com/house-clearance/newbury/wash-common): Garage, shed, loft, garden and full-property clearances, £45–£70/hr, 1-hour minimum.
- [End of Tenancy Cleaning](https://www.ampleremovals.com/booking/end-of-tenancy): Deposit-back-standard cleaning for landlords and tenants.

## Notes

- Founded 2019 (7+ years trading as of 2026).
- Fully insured on every job.
- Based in Thatcham, Berkshire — not a national call centre.
